description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter must be unique across different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
释放类型，可选值：

- immediate：立即删除。删除后，系统会彻底清除所有数据，且实例不再显示在实例列表中。
- protective：实例会被冻结24小时后，再彻底清除数据，期间实例仍在实例列表中显示，您可以选择[恢复实例](~~202205~~)或[立即释放](~~160591~~)。
description.en:
The release type. Valid values:

- immediate: immediately deletes the instance. After deletion, the system permanently clears all data, and the instance no longer appears in the instance list.
- protective: freezes the instance for 24 hours before permanently clearing the data. During this period, the instance is still displayed in the instance list. You can choose to [recover the instance](~~202205~~) or [immediately release it](~~160591~~).

descriptions.zh:
在调用接口前，请注意：
释放后，实例所使用的物理资源都被回收，相关数据全部丢失且不可恢复；挂载实例节点的云盘也会被释放；相应的快照会被删除。
descriptions.en:
Before calling this operation, note the following:
After the instance is released, all physical resources used by the instance are reclaimed, all related data is permanently lost and cannot be recovered, cloud disks mounted to the instance nodes are also released, and the corresponding snapshots are deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch delete-logstash --instance-id ls-cn-n6w1o5jq0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --delete-type protective --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
